market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: At ~$62 current WTI, a drop to $40 is a 35% decline. With >14 months to go, historical volatility and current macro risks (trade war, recession fears, OPEC+ supply) support a roughly 8% chance of a settlement print <= $40. The market-implied 1.1% appears too low.
evidence_points: Annualized volatility of crude oil is typically 30-40%, allowing a $22 move in 14 months within 1-2 standard deviations
OPEC+ has begun unwinding production cuts, and U.S. shale break-even prices are in the $40-$50 range, but a recession could temporarily push prices below cost support
sources_consulted: General knowledge of OPEC+ and macro conditions
